summary: Backend-only verification of the Whisper cloud STT fallback (mic-on-all-devices fix). 24 pytest cases against POST /api/voice/transcribe + chat sanity: 15 PASS / 9 FAIL. All 9 failures document the SAME critical bug — server.py's WHISPER_SUPPORTED set (line 703-706) includes 9 ISO codes (bn, te, gu, ml, pa, or, as, sa, sd) that the Emergent Whisper proxy REJECTS with HTTP 400 'unsupported_language'. Because server.py forwards those codes as `language=` to the proxy, users speaking Bengali/Telugu/Gujarati/Malayalam/Punjabi/Odia/Assamese/Sanskrit/Sindhi get HTTP 500 on every mic release — the exact 'silent failure' the WhatsApp-parity fix was meant to eliminate. Confirmed-passing codes: en, hi, ta, mr, kn, ur, ne. All other review-request items PASS: (a) no `language` field → 200 with {text}, (b) unsupported code 'sat' / 'xyzzy' → gracefully ignored (200), (c) empty audio → 500 with 'Transcription failed', (d) missing auth → 401, (e) missing file → 422, (f) chat/stream basic smoke works, (g) RTI Rule 3 citation returned for 'What is the RTI application fee?' — corpus expansion verified.

critical.issue: WHISPER_SUPPORTED set at server.py:703-706 includes 9 codes {bn, te, gu, ml, pa, or, as, sa, sd} that the Emergent Whisper proxy rejects with HTTP 400 'unsupported_language'. Backend then bubbles up HTTP 500 'Transcription failed'. Result: mic silently fails for every user speaking those 9 Indian languages — same UX pain as the pre-fix native STT bug. Confirmed-accepted set by Emergent proxy: {en, hi, ta, mr, kn, ur, ne}. Recommended fix: EITHER (A) shrink WHISPER_SUPPORTED to the confirmed-accepted set, OR (B) wrap the Whisper call in a try/except that catches 'unsupported_language' and retries WITHOUT the language kwarg (this preserves the language hint accuracy boost for supported codes and falls back to auto-detect for the rest — closest to the intended spec 'gracefully IGNORE the hint and still transcribe').

integration_issues.flow: Frontend Whisper STT via stopRecording() → whisperTranscribeFile(...) with language?.code
integration_issues.issue: app/(tabs)/index.tsx passes the app's selected language code straight through as the `language` form field. When the user's language is one of the 9 proxy-rejected codes, the backend 500 propagates as `throw new Error(data.detail || 'Transcription failed')` in stt.ts:361 — the mic tap will surface an alert or silent error. Fix on the backend (see backend_issues.critical) is sufficient; no frontend change required.

server.py:711-715 forwards `language=lang` when in the local set, but there is no retry-on-400 path. A single try/except retry would satisfy review-request item #3 for ALL 22 Indian languages instead of the current 7.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: server.py declares WHISPER_SUPPORTED = {en, hi, bn, ta, te, mr, gu, kn, ml, pa, or, as, ur, sa, sd, ne} (line 703-706) based on OpenAI's public Whisper language list. However the Emergent proxy layer (integrations.emergentagent.com/llm/openai/v1) rejects 9 of those codes with HTTP 400 'unsupported_language'. server.py then converts that 400 into HTTP 500 'Transcription failed'. REPRODUCTION: `curl -X POST $URL/api/voice/transcribe -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -F audio=@/tmp/test_audio.m4a -F language=bn` → 500. Same for te/gu/ml/pa/or/as/sa/sd. MITIGATION (main agent to apply): patch server.py:716 with `try: return await oc.audio.transcriptions.create(**kwargs) except BadRequestError as e: if 'unsupported_language' in str(e).lower(): kwargs.pop('language', None); return await oc.audio.transcriptions.create(**kwargs); raise`. This makes item #3 of the review request ('gracefully IGNORE and still transcribe') work for ALL 22 Indian languages, honouring the WhatsApp-parity promise.
